tasks.short: Evaluate new technologies and methods and recommend their use.

steps.what: Define actual laboratory technology and method needs, evaluation criteria and acceptable uncertainty
inputs: actual laboratory needs and existing validated methods
applicable internal evaluation requirements
outputs: analyst-defined evaluation criteria and trial scope

steps.what: Retrieve and check new technology specifications, method literature and existing validation evidence against the criteria
inputs: analyst-defined evaluation criteria and trial scope
actual supplier documents and method literature
outputs: checked source comparison with unsupported claims marked

steps.what: Perform or participate in authorized isolated method trials and capture actual results, conditions and failures
inputs: existing approved trial instructions
actual samples and instruments
checked source comparison with unsupported claims marked
outputs: actual local trial observations and raw data draft

steps.what: Calculate method performance comparisons from actual trial data and examine mismatches, missing data and uncertainty
inputs: actual local trial observations and raw data draft
analyst-defined evaluation criteria and trial scope
approved comparison formulas

steps.what: Evaluate the new technologies and methods and choose a recommendation regarding their use in the actual laboratory
inputs: checked performance comparison and limits
checked source comparison with unsupported claims marked
actual laboratory needs and constraints
outputs: analyst's technology or method recommendation and rationale

steps.what: Write the actual evaluation note and internal recommendation message with supporting evidence and unresolved validation needs
inputs: analyst's technology or method recommendation and rationale
checked performance comparison and limits
actual local trial observations and raw data draft
outputs: complete method evaluation record and internal advice package

steps.what: Approve the final actual evaluation record, evidence bundle, recommendation message and exact internal recipients
inputs: complete method evaluation record and internal advice package

steps.what: Commit the approved evaluation and actual trial evidence bundle to the internal evaluation record
inputs: approved technology evaluation version

steps.what: Send the approved use recommendation and evaluation link to the named internal laboratory decision owner
inputs: approved technology evaluation version
versioned technology and method evaluation

tasks.design: Configure indexed source and trial-evidence views in {DOCS} and {OTHER}, the existing LIMS and quality evaluation system. Native {SPREADSHEET} templates calculate exact comparisons from actual trial data. Criteria, authorized physical trials, uncertainty assessment and recommendations stay human. The actual evidence bundle, evaluation note and {EMAIL} advice are complete before approval, separate internal record commit and send. Changes void approval. No model, automatic method adoption, instrument control or product release is proposed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Source retrieval and repeated comparison calculations consume evaluation preparation time.
tasks.enabler_now: Native evidence indexing and validated comparison templates.
tasks.still_hard: Representative trials, uncertainty and transfer to the actual laboratory.
tasks.human_edge: Judge whether evidence is sufficient to recommend use.

ambition.what: Reduce mechanical preparation within current method evaluations.

tasks.altitude: Scientific method evaluation remains with the analyst.

reach.learn: Treat evaluation advice as distinct from validated operational adoption.

evidence.claim: Native document indexing and fixed spreadsheet comparisons can organize actual method evaluation evidence.

assumptions: Shares are provisional, not measured. s1 defines actual laboratory needs and criteria; s2 manually reads and captures source identity, date, method conditions and performance claims when structured records are missing.

s3 retains all analyst time for authorized trials and manual capture of sample/instrument ID, method/version, actual result/unit, condition, time and failure. Planned test instructions are not actual results.
s4 includes manual data reconciliation and checking formula applicability, uncertainty and missing observations; no complete comparison dataset is assumed free.

This models evaluation inside an already authorized isolated trial process. New trial authorization, operational implementation, validation approval or procurement must be separately counted when required; none is credited as a saving here.
The record commit includes the actual local trial evidence draft and evaluation bundle. Any formal report also covered by task 16964 must have overlapping document work allocated once.
unknowns: Actual trial mix, native evidence coverage and validated comparison templates.
research_questions: How much retrieval and calculation remains after actual capture and uncertainty checks?

already_counted.description: Actual trials, comparison checking and final evaluation preparation/review.

incremental.description: Maintain source indexing and validated comparison templates.

approvals.approved_version: complete actual evaluation and trial evidence bundle with exact internal record destination
exact recommendation message, evaluation link and internal laboratory decision owner

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High: eight retrieval,7.5 comparison and one actual recommendation-send hour saved less one upkeep. Low: incompatible sources and existing routing erase the benefit. Same-evaluation-record commitment, actual trials and scientific judgement retain full effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Scientific evaluation with native evidence retrieval and deterministic comparisons.
reach: Laboratory decision owners receive supported recommendations without automatic method adoption.
role.ambitious_version: Reduce repeated preparation while preserving actual trials and scientific judgement.
